subject: Pricing request ESM survey study
body:
Dear avicenna team,

I am a PhD researcher at the University of Amsterdam and am setting up an experience sampling study. I am considering my options for which app to use, and Avicenna looks like it fits our interests. Would it be possible to provide me with an indication of the pricing?

We will only use survey data. At first, we will conduct a pilot study with max 20 participants. The full study will consist of around 200 participants.

Please let me know if you need more information from us. I am looking forward to your response.

Best wishes,

Elyan Aarts

PhD Candidate

University of Amsterdam

The Netherlands

subject: Pricing request ESM survey study
body:
Dear Elyan, 

I hope you're doing well. 

My name is Hanna from Avicenna and I would be more than happy to help you with your request. Generally, our pricing depends on three factors:

  1. The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well)
  2. The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study)
  3. The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll

I would be able to provide you with an exact quote if you let me know of the participation period of your study. 

Sincerely,
Hanna

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada

Maryam Hashemian Marked Study #4085 as "Pending" to ensure their pilot data is kept. Please inform me if they choose to proceed with the big study, and we can incorporate both studies into their license. Thank you.

Sara Farnya, So in such cases when I heard from a client that they have created a pilot study I should go to the study on Sales Dash and mark it as pending otherwise their data will be lost. Am I correct?

Also regarding the draft email, seems Mohammad has forgotten to review that. Could you please see if it's good to go?!

Maryam Hashemian I did not forget to review it. I put a note for you here:

https://file.avicennaresearch.com/chat/ethicastaff/pl/a7jttekjwbnszregggpgiic6cr

And said:

> for ticket Ticket#25127 please do not reply to her anymore. It's already too late to get back with this reply. For cases like this, just go ahead and send the email. You do not have to ask for confirmation for everything you want to say.

Maryam Hashemian It's not our default procedure to mark studies as "Pending," and we only do so when necessary. We've offered this client a free pilot study, and they are interested in proceeding with it. I just wanted to ensure we keep their data until they're ready for the main study. While we could issue a separate license for their pilot, I believe it's best not to, as they haven't made a final decision yet. Thanks.

Mohammad Hashemian
Apologies, I forgot that I had already received your response on MM. I will make sure to reply to such messages directly in the future.

Sara Farnya
Thanks for letting me know.

Hi Elyan,

Thank you very much for the update. I'm glad to see that everything is progressing smoothly.

Regarding the next steps, if you share the following information with me, I'll go ahead and send you the invoice and will issue your license as soon as the payment is made.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to let me know.

Looking forward to supporting your study.
Best,
Maryam
